ui.shell.rail.ask.aria.tone: Compact panel action or status; preserve the destination and pending-work distinction.
ui.shell.rail.ask.aria.note: Subject is the queue owner text from the chat-owned ask classifier, retained verbatim; tooltip remains delegated to that same owner.
ui.shell.rail.ask.aria.length: One tooltip or accessible name; exact counts are never badge-capped.

placeholders.chord: Empty when unbound, otherwise the already-formatted platform keyboard chord including leading space and parentheses.
placeholders.subject: Already-formatted queue scope: this conversation or all conversations.

ui.shell.rail.ask.aria_count.tone: Compact panel action or status; preserve the destination and pending-work distinction.
ui.shell.rail.ask.aria_count.note: Ask count is the answerable asks only: a timed-out ask is read-only and is not counted, so the count is waiting alone.
ui.shell.rail.ask.aria_count.length: One tooltip or accessible name; exact counts are never badge-capped.

placeholders.chord: Empty when unbound, otherwise the already-formatted platform keyboard chord including leading space and parentheses.
placeholders.subject: Chat-owned already-formatted queue scope.
placeholders.countText: Existing decimal count text from String(count); separate from ICU cardinal so English does not gain thousands separators.

ui.shell.rail.ask.aria_count.plural_guidance: English one/other is source grammar, not a target-locale limit. Russian needs native few/many; Arabic needs zero/two and native few/many where appropriate. Keep count-invariant English status words unchanged while allowing native agreement.
